partial.description: The original is one volume of an account printed in several originals: its 款 are some of the account's, so the sum and digit checks of the unit are reported, not enforced.

pages.description: The part of the account's scope this table reads ([first, last] physical pages): one original printing several divisions' tables of the account.

division.description: The division (所属) whose share of the account the original prints: its 款・項・目 carry that division's amounts, and the tables of one account's divisions add up to the account (ADR 0030).

name_corrections.description: 文字層・OCR の名称の誤読の訂正。原画で確かめた印字に直す。頁・番号・読んだ名称で1つのノードに結び付け、見つからなければ止める。
